name: Principal Skinner
source:
Principal of Springfield Elementary School, and a veteran of the Vietnam war.

His repeated error have garnered him intense contempt from Superintendent Chalmers, but he intends to lessen those feelings today by inviting his superior to a luncheon.

Hohoho, it will surely be unforgettable.

[From in-game profile]
